key: It's just a plush...
en: It's just a plush...
ja: ただのぬいぐるみだ……

key: A tag underneath it reads "justvulpix".
en: A tag underneath it reads "justvulpix".
ja: 下に付いているタグには「justvulpix」と書かれている。

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: A secret switch!
en: A secret switch!
ja: 隠しスイッチだ!

key: Press it?
en: Press it?
ja: 押しますか?

key: Who wouldn't?
en: Who wouldn't?
ja: 押さない理由がある?

key: Better not...
en: Better not...
ja: やめておいたほうが……

key: A record book lists names of Reborn League Leaders, past and present.
en: A record book lists names of Reborn League Leaders, past and present.
ja: 記録簿には、歴代のリボーンリーグリーダーの名前が記されている。

key: Most of the names are familiar, but one is circled in red:
en: Most of the names are familiar, but one is circled in red:
ja: ほとんどの名前は見覚えがあるが、一つだけ赤丸が付けられている:

key: "Euphie"
en: "Euphie"
ja: 「ユーフィ」

key: ADRIENN: Ah, \PN.
en: ADRIENN: Ah, \PN.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ああ、\PN。

key: You are a sight for sore eyes as always.
en: You are a sight for sore eyes as always.
ja: 相変わらず、君を見ると救われる気がするよ。

key: I would like little more than to chat and hear all about how your ascent to the championship has been going,
en: I would like little more than to chat and hear all about how your ascent to the championship has been going,
ja: 君がチャンピオンへの道をどう歩んでいるか、ゆっくり話を聞きたいのはやまやまなのだが、

key: But I'm afraid I am beyond swamped with these emails.
en: But I'm afraid I am beyond swamped with these emails.
ja: あいにく、このメールの山にすっかり埋もれてしまっていてね。

key: I admit that it's nobody's fault but my own for taking on so many projects at once, but...
en: I admit that it's nobody's fault but my own for taking on so many projects at once, but...
ja: 一度にこれほど多くの案件を抱え込んだのは、わたし自身のせいだと認めるが……

key: I firmly believe that for the sake of everyone in the city, it will be beyond worth it.
en: I firmly believe that for the sake of everyone in the city, it will be beyond worth it.
ja: この街のみんなのためになるなら、それだけの価値は必ずあると信じているよ。

key: ADRIENN: That one has taken a liking to me, it seems...
en: ADRIENN: That one has taken a liking to me, it seems...
ja: アドリエンヌ: あの子は、わたしのことを気に入ったようだ……

key: Jumped up there and hasn't left since.
en: Jumped up there and hasn't left since.
ja: そこに飛び乗ってから、ずっと離れないんだ。

key: I'll say, though, I find this turn of events rather agreeable.
en: I'll say, though, I find this turn of events rather agreeable.
ja: とはいえ、この成り行きは、なかなか悪くないと思っているよ。

key: ADRIENN: Repairing that room is going to be an additional headache...
en: ADRIENN: Repairing that room is going to be an additional headache...
ja: アドリエンヌ: あの部屋の修理は、また新たな頭痛の種になりそうだ……

key: But I must admit...
en: But I must admit...
ja: だが、認めなければなるまい……

key: I somewhat relish the thought that an elongated repair process will be reason for me to ask the ambassador not to come in for some time.
en: I somewhat relish the thought that an elongated repair process will be reason for me to ask the ambassador not to come in for some time.
ja: 修理が長引けば、しばらく大使に来ないよう頼む理由にもなると思うと、少しばかり心が浮き立つのだ。

key: And it's true that there may be some binding documents destroyed in the process...
en: And it's true that there may be some binding documents destroyed in the process...
ja: それに、その過程で契約書類がいくつか失われた可能性があるのも事実だが……

key: But I am not about to admit that to that woman.
en: But I am not about to admit that to that woman.
ja: あの女にそれを認めるつもりは、わたしにはない。

key: No, sir.
en: No, sir.
ja: ああ、絶対にね。

key: No, ma'am.
en: No, ma'am.
ja: ああ、絶対にね。

key: No way.
en: No way.
ja: あり得ない。

key: Her heart's in the right place, but she is enough of a menace without me encouraging her.
en: Her heart's in the right place, but she is enough of a menace without me encouraging her.
ja: 心根は悪くないのだが、わたしがけしかけずとも、あの人は十分に厄介なのでね。

key: I am tired.
en: I am tired.
ja: 疲れたよ。

key: ADRIENN: Thank you, Shaylee.
en: ADRIENN: Thank you, Shaylee.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ありがとう、シェイリー。

key: You always understand.
en: You always understand.
ja: 君はいつも分かってくれる。

key: VICTORIA: Oh, \PN, they let you in?
en: VICTORIA: Oh, \PN, they let you in?
ja: ヴィクトリア: あら、\PN、中に入れてもらえたんですね?

key: Not that that's a problem!
en: Not that that's a problem!
ja: 問題があるわけじゃないですけど!

key: Frankly I could use the company...
en: Frankly I could use the company...
ja: 正直、話し相手が欲しかったところです……

key: This desk work is completely mind-numbing...
en: This desk work is completely mind-numbing...
ja: このデスクワーク、頭がしびれてきそうで……

key: I'm used to being out there and moving my body!
en: I'm used to being out there and moving my body!
ja: 外で体を動かすほうが性に合ってるんです!

key: All this computer stuff is such a drag-- how can anyone just sit here all day!?
en: All this computer stuff is such a drag-- how can anyone just sit here all day!?
ja: パソコン作業なんて面倒で――一日中座っていられる人の気が知れません!

key: But uggggggh-- the paperwork never ceases...
en: But uggggggh-- the paperwork never ceases...
ja: でも、うぅぅ……書類仕事が終わらないんです……

key: VICTORIA: I should call Julia and ask for some of her strongest...
en: VICTORIA: I should call Julia and ask for some of her strongest...
ja: ヴィクトリア: ジュリアに電話して、一番強いのを分けてもらおうかしら……

key: VICTORIA: I must be seriously over-tired...
en: VICTORIA: I must be seriously over-tired...
ja: ヴィクトリア: よほど疲れがたまっているようですね……

key: Most people count Mareep; I'm about to be counting Vulpix to sleep here...
en: Most people count Mareep; I'm about to be counting Vulpix to sleep here...
ja: 普通の人はメリープを数えて眠るけど、わたしはロコンを数えることになりそう……

key: So, the proposed Railnet would feature eight stations, one for each ward, correct?
en: So, the proposed Railnet would feature eight stations, one for each ward, correct?
ja: それで、計画中の鉄道網は、各区に一駅ずつ、計8駅を設ける予定なんですよね?

key: But placing a station in Opal Ward is inefficient considering the water's placement and underground structure of the Grand Hall.
en: But placing a station in Opal Ward is inefficient considering the water's placement and underground structure of the Grand Hall.
ja: でも、水の配置や大ホールの地下構造を考えると、オパール区に駅を置くのは非効率です。

key: Is there really a need for an Opal Station when Grandview is so close by?
en: Is there really a need for an Opal Station when Grandview is so close by?
ja: グランドビューがこんなに近いのに、オパール駅は本当に必要なんでしょうか?

key: Ah, geez...
en: Ah, geez...
ja: ああ、まったく……

key: So after much ado, Reborn's Railnet system is finally rebuilt and active,
en: So after much ado, Reborn's Railnet system is finally rebuilt and active,
ja: さんざん苦労した末、リボーンの鉄道網はようやく再建されて動き出したんですけど、

key: But there's just one problem.
en: But there's just one problem.
ja: 一つだけ問題があって。

key: There's a part of the Railnet that we haven't been able to properly repair.
en: There's a part of the Railnet that we haven't been able to properly repair.
ja: 鉄道網の一部が、きちんと修理できていないんです。

key: The whole thing is overrun with angry Pokémon!
en: The whole thing is overrun with angry Pokémon!
ja: そこ全体が、怒ったポケモンだらけになっちゃって!

key: And yeah-- I get it.
en: And yeah-- I get it.
ja: ええ――分かってはいるんです。

key: A bunch of humans marched into their home and messed it all up.
en: A bunch of humans marched into their home and messed it all up.
ja: 人間の集団があいつらの住処に踏み込んで、めちゃくちゃにしたんですから。

key: But that's their fault for infesting it in the first place!
en: But that's their fault for infesting it in the first place!
ja: でも、そもそもあそこに住み着いたのはあいつらのせいでしょ!

key: Ugh.
en: Ugh.
ja: はぁ。

key: Hey, listen, you're that ace Champion Trainer or whatever that Adrienn's always talking about, right?
en: Hey, listen, you're that ace Champion Trainer or whatever that Adrienn's always talking about, right?
ja: ねえ、あんた、アドリエンヌがいつも話してるあのエースのチャンピオントレーナーとかいう人でしょ?

key: You think you could do us a favor and go have a word with those Pokémon?
en: You think you could do us a favor and go have a word with those Pokémon?
ja: あのポケモンたちと話をつけてくれたりしない?

key: I'll ask one of the guys to leave the door unlocked for you.
en: I'll ask one of the guys to leave the door unlocked for you.
ja: 誰かに頼んで、あんたのためにドアの鍵を開けとかせるから。

key: You can find the entrance to the part that they've gathered in the Byxbysion Ward.
en: You can find the entrance to the part that they've gathered in the Byxbysion Ward.
ja: やつらが集まってる場所への入口は、ビクスビジョン区にあるよ。

key: Er-- Wasteland, sorry.
en: Er-- Wasteland, sorry.
ja: あ――荒地だった、ごめん。

key: Byxbysion was originally going to be its own ward so we extended the railnet to there, but then it obviously didn't work out.
en: Byxbysion was originally going to be its own ward so we extended the railnet to there, but then it obviously didn't work out.
ja: ビクスビジョンは元々独立した区になる予定で、それで鉄道網をそこまで延ばしたんだけど、まあ結局うまくいかなかったのよね。

key: And of course now that part of it is an issue.
en: And of course now that part of it is an issue.
ja: で、もちろん今はそこが問題になってるってわけ。

key: It'd be a huge help if you could do something though.
en: It'd be a huge help if you could do something though.
ja: でも、何とかしてくれたら本当に助かるんだけど。

key: You think you could do us a favor and go have a word with those Pokémon in the Railnet?
en: You think you could do us a favor and go have a word with those Pokémon in the Railnet?
ja: 鉄道網にいるあのポケモンたちと話をつけてくれたりしない?

key: You can find the entrance to the part that they've gathered in in the Byxbysion Wasteland.
en: You can find the entrance to the part that they've gathered in in the Byxbysion Wasteland.
ja: やつらが集まってる場所への入口は、ビクスビジョン荒地にあるよ。

key: Howdy! I hear you were able to clean up those Pokémon for us!
en: Howdy! I hear you were able to clean up those Pokémon for us!
ja: よう! あのポケモンたちを片付けてくれたんだって!

key: Thanks a ton, pal! We'll get that section of the city tidied up now too.
en: Thanks a ton, pal! We'll get that section of the city tidied up now too.
ja: 本当に助かったぜ、相棒! これで街のあの区画もきれいにできる。

key: By the way, I heard the crew found this when they went to check the area out.
en: By the way, I heard the crew found this when they went to check the area out.
ja: ところで、作業員たちがあの辺りを調べに行った時、これを見つけたらしいぜ。

key: Oh, and there was one more thing too--
en: Oh, and there was one more thing too--
ja: ああ、それともう一つあったな――

key: Consider them payment.
en: Consider them payment.
ja: 報酬だと思ってくれ。

key: Call it payment.
en: Call it payment.
ja: 報酬ってことでな。

key: Now, let's consider plans for the Byxbysion Ward.
en: Now, let's consider plans for the Byxbysion Ward.
ja: さて、ビクスビジョン区の計画について考えてみましょう。

key: It may be in the distant future, but I see it as a possibility for Reborn's most cultured ward yet!
en: It may be in the distant future, but I see it as a possibility for Reborn's most cultured ward yet!
ja: まだ遠い未来の話かもしれないけど、リボーン一の文化的な区になる可能性を秘めていると思うんです!

key: We've been dedicated to revising our policies so that we can act quickly if Reborn City ever gets nearly as bad as it was before.
en: We've been dedicated to revising our policies so that we can act quickly if Reborn City ever gets nearly as bad as it was before.
ja: リボーンシティが以前ほどひどい状態に戻りかけたとき、すぐに対応できるよう、方針の見直しに力を入れてきました。

key: Some people insist we're being too subjective with what we punish for, but if you ask me, that's better than doing nothing!
en: Some people insist we're being too subjective with what we punish for, but if you ask me, that's better than doing nothing!
ja: 何を罰するかについて主観的すぎるって言う人もいるけど、あたしに言わせれば、何もしないよりずっとましよ!

key: Victoria always seems so stressed!
en: Victoria always seems so stressed!
ja: ヴィクトリアさん、いつもストレスたまってそうよね!

key: I wish there were more I could do.
en: I wish there were more I could do.
ja: もっと何かしてあげられたらいいんだけど。

key: I try to take her out for coffee now and then, but it seems like she really just misses her school.
en: I try to take her out for coffee now and then, but it seems like she really just misses her school.
ja: たまにコーヒーに誘ってみるんだけど、本当は学校が恋しいだけみたい。

key: Drinks can't solve that, I'm afraid.
en: Drinks can't solve that, I'm afraid.
ja: 飲み物じゃ、それは解決できないわよね。

key: Six more registering Trainers have departed for the region from the Kanto-Johto area.
en: Six more registering Trainers have departed for the region from the Kanto-Johto area.
ja: カントー・ジョウト地方から、また6人のトレーナーがこちらの地方に向けて出発しました。

key: Please make sure to prepare their registrations properly in advance.
en: Please make sure to prepare their registrations properly in advance.
ja: 事前に、きちんと登録の準備をしておいてください。

key: This morning I came in and found Adrienn passed out on xyr desk.
en: This morning I came in and found Adrienn passed out on xyr desk.
ja: 今朝出勤したら、アドリエンヌが机に突っ伏して寝落ちしてたわ。

key: Again.
en: Again.
ja: またしても。

key: I'm thinking we should just turn the old director's office into a bedroom for xem at this point.
en: I'm thinking we should just turn the old director's office into a bedroom for xem at this point.
ja: もう、古い部長室をあの子用の寝室に改造したほうがいいんじゃないかしら。

key: Director's Office
en: Director's Office
ja: 部長室

key: Trainer Data Center
en: Trainer Data Center
ja: トレーナーデータセンター

key: Starter Pokémon Storage
en: Starter Pokémon Storage
ja: 御三家ポケモン保管室

key: Legal Office
en: Legal Office
ja: 法務室

key: RPRP Office
en: RPRP Office
ja: RPRPオフィス

key: Inspector's Office
en: Inspector's Office
ja: 検査官室

key: Corporate
en: Corporate
ja: 企業部

key: Always an honor to have you around.
en: Always an honor to have you around.
ja: あなたにお会いできて、いつも光栄です。

key: I dunno where they all came from, but I think these little guys are cute.
en: I dunno where they all came from, but I think these little guys are cute.
ja: どこから来たのか知らないけど、この子たちってかわいいと思うの。

key: They add a nice touch to the atmosphere.
en: They add a nice touch to the atmosphere.
ja: 雰囲気がいい感じになるし。

key: Good for employee morale.
en: Good for employee morale.
ja: 従業員の士気にもいいわよね。

key: But it would be nice if they would stop making it snow inside.
en: But it would be nice if they would stop making it snow inside.
ja: でも、室内に雪を降らせるのだけはやめてほしいけど。

key: This office is for the Azurine Restoration Project.
en: This office is for the Azurine Restoration Project.
ja: このオフィスは、アズリン再生計画のためのものです。

key: Just as soon as the project receives the adequate funding, we'll do our best to get the Pokémon of the area in ship shape to ensure their future in Reborn.
en: Just as soon as the project receives the adequate funding, we'll do our best to get the Pokémon of the area in ship shape to ensure their future in Reborn.
ja: 計画に十分な資金が確保され次第、あの地域のポケモンたちを万全な状態にし、リボーンでの未来を確かなものにするために全力を尽くします。

key: Oh, hello. \PN, was it, yes?
en: Oh, hello. \PN, was it, yes?
ja: ああ、こんにちは。\PN、でしたよね?

key: I hear you're the one who funded the reconstruction of the Azurine Nature Center. Thank you so much for taking an interest in the Pokémon's future!
en: I hear you're the one who funded the reconstruction of the Azurine Nature Center. Thank you so much for taking an interest in the Pokémon's future!
ja: アズリン自然センターの再建に資金を出してくださったのは、あなただと伺いました。ポケモンたちの未来に関心を寄せてくださり、本当にありがとうございます!

key: If you are willing to help out just a little more, I've received word that the Island Center is waiting on a few Pokémon samples that we haven't acquired yet.
en: If you are willing to help out just a little more, I've received word that the Island Center is waiting on a few Pokémon samples that we haven't acquired yet.
ja: もう少しだけお力をお借りできるなら、島のセンターがまだ入手できていないポケモンのサンプルを待っているとの連絡を受けています。

key: If you have any spare time and interest, would you mind heading down to the Azurine Center and seeing if you can contribute anything for them?
en: If you have any spare time and interest, would you mind heading down to the Azurine Center and seeing if you can contribute anything for them?
ja: もしお時間とご興味があれば、アズリンセンターまで足を運んで、何か力になれることがないか見ていただけませんか?

key: Oh, it's you!
en: Oh, it's you!
ja: あら、あなただったのね!

key: I got word just a bit ago that you were able to help out the Azurine Center!
en: I got word just a bit ago that you were able to help out the Azurine Center!
ja: さきほど、あなたがアズリンセンターを助けてくれたと連絡がありました!

key: Thank you so much for going out of your way to protect the future of Pokémon in Reborn!
en: Thank you so much for going out of your way to protect the future of Pokémon in Reborn!
ja: リボーンのポケモンたちの未来を守るために、わざわざ力を貸してくださって、本当にありがとうございます!

key: Here-- we found this a little while ago when we were constructing the new center.
en: Here-- we found this a little while ago when we were constructing the new center.
ja: こちらを――少し前に、新しいセンターを建設している時に見つけたものです。

key: Hopefully you can make good use of it!
en: Hopefully you can make good use of it!
ja: 役立てていただければ幸いです!

key: Azurine Island is going to flourish!
en: Azurine Island is going to flourish!
ja: アズリン島は、きっと繁栄していくでしょう!

key: And from it, so shall all the Pokémon in Reborn!
en: And from it, so shall all the Pokémon in Reborn!
ja: そしてそこから、リボーンのすべてのポケモンも、共に栄えていくのです!

key: Who're.... Oh. You must be \PN.
en: Who're.... Oh. You must be \PN.
ja: 誰だ……ああ。お前が\PNか。

key: Right. All you need to know about me is that my name is Kanaya.
en: Right. All you need to know about me is that my name is Kanaya.
ja: そう。あたしについて知っておくべきことは、名前がカナヤだってことだけ。

key: Ame called me down from Hoenn to help before her... well... yeah.
en: Ame called me down from Hoenn to help before her...  well... yeah.
ja: アメがホウエンから呼び寄せたのよ、手伝わせるために……その、まあ……そういうこと。

key: Look, ever since the Restoration Project went into full swing,
en: Look, ever since the Restoration Project went into full swing,
ja: いい、再生計画が本格的に動き出してから、

key: We've been swamped with new Trainers coming from all over and we're experiencing a shortage of starter Pokémon to hand out to the new people.
en: We've been swamped with new Trainers coming from all over and we're experiencing a shortage of starter Pokémon to hand out to the new people.
ja: 各地から来る新人トレーナーであたしたちは手一杯で、新人に配る御三家ポケモンが不足してるの。

key: That's where you come in.
en: That's where you come in.
ja: そこであんたの出番ってわけ。

key: We need Eggs. From the usual starters anyways.
en: We need Eggs. From the usual starters anyways.
ja: タマゴが必要なの。とりあえず、いつもの御三家のね。

key: For every three Eggs you turn in, I'm liable to give you a reward.
en: For every three Eggs you turn in, I'm liable to give you a reward.
ja: タマゴを3個持ってくるごとに、報酬をあげることになってるわ。

key: So, are you willing to help or not?
en: So, are you willing to help or not?
ja: で、手伝う気はある、ない?

key: Great. Fantastic.
en: Great. Fantastic.
ja: よし。最高。

key: The faster you get this shit done, the quicker I can get assigned to something more productive.
en: The faster you get this shit done, the quicker I can get assigned to something more productive.
ja: このクソ仕事を早く片付けてくれれば、あたしももっと生産的な仕事に回してもらえるんだから。

key: Refer to the chart over by the door then.
en: Refer to the chart over by the door then.
ja: それじゃ、ドアのそばにある表を見て。

key: It has a list of what we need.
en: It has a list of what we need.
ja: 必要なもののリストが書いてあるから。

key: Well, fine then. We don't need your help anyway.
en: Well, fine then. We don't need your help anyway.
ja: ま、いいわ。どうせあんたの助けなんていらないし。

key: I'll go out and do it myself if I have to.
en: I'll go out and do it myself if I have to.
ja: 必要なら、あたし自身で外に出てやるから。

key: And I'd get to keep all these rewards to myself.
en: And I'd get to keep all these rewards to myself.
ja: それに、報酬だって全部あたしのものになるしね。

key: But whatever, your loss.
en: But whatever, your loss.
ja: でも、まあいいわ。あんたの損よ。

key: Oh, it's you again. Got another Egg?
en: Oh, it's you again. Got another Egg?
ja: ああ、また来たの。タマゴ、また持ってきた?

key: If so, hand it over, please.
en: If so, hand it over, please.
ja: そうなら、渡して。

en: I'll see you around, \PN!

en: Geez, the inspector's been out forever again.

en: VICTORIA: And I suppose that's everything...

key: It'll still be some time before we get the resources needed to put it into action, but the planning and coordination can begin already.
en: It'll still be some time before we get the resources needed to put it into action, but the planning and coordination can begin already.
ja: 実行に必要な資源がそろうまでにはまだ時間がかかりますが、計画と調整はもう始められます。

key: Frankly, I'll be happy to have it off my plate.
en: Frankly, I'll be happy to have it off my plate.
ja: 正直、これが片付いてくれるとほっとします。

key: The new project manager should be here any moment...
en: The new project manager should be here any moment...
ja: 新しいプロジェクトマネージャーが、もうすぐ来るはずなんですけど……

key: He was just on a brief trip to Kalos, so I'm sure he's had a busy return.
en: He was just on a brief trip to Kalos, so I'm sure he's had a busy return.
ja: カロスへ短い旅行に出ていたので、きっと戻ってきてからも忙しいはずです。

key: ...But personally, I'm glad he came back at all.
en: ...But personally, I'm glad he came back at all.
ja: ……でも、個人的には、彼が戻ってきてくれただけでうれしいです。

key: I wondered, for a bit.
en: I wondered, for a bit.
ja: 少しの間、不安だったので。

key: I've got to hurry off to another session, but it shouldn't be long.
en: I've got to hurry off to another session, but it shouldn't be long.
ja: 別の打ち合わせに急がなくてはいけませんが、長くはかからないはずです。

key: CAIN: Heyyy, I'm not late, am I?
en: CAIN: Heyyy, I'm not late, am I?
ja: カイン: よー、遅刻はしてねーよな?

key: Kalos was awesome--
en: Kalos was awesome--
ja: カロスは最高だったぜ――

key: I'll have to tell you all about the stuff Dad and I saw later.
en: I'll have to tell you all about the stuff Dad and I saw later.
ja: 父さんと見てきたもの、あとで全部話してやるよ。

key: CAIN: ...Oh, I'm totally late.
en: CAIN: ...Oh, I'm totally late.
ja: カイン: ……あ、めっちゃ遅刻してるじゃん。

key: Well, that's fine.
en: Well, that's fine.
ja: ま、いっか。

key: CAIN: So, are you my cute-as-a-button secretary~?
en: CAIN: So, are you my cute-as-a-button secretary~?
ja: カイン: で、お前がオレのかわいい秘書ちゃんってわけ~?

key: I know you had that Champion thing going on, but I'd understand if you gave it up for me.
en: I know you had that Champion thing going on, but I'd understand if you gave it up for me.
ja: チャンピオンの仕事があるのは知ってるけど、オレのために辞めたって言うなら分かるぜ。

key: After all, who wouldn't wanna work under me~?
en: After all, who wouldn't wanna work under me~?
ja: だって、オレの下で働きたくないやついないだろ~?

key: CAIN: You know, I never expected to have an office job.
en: CAIN: You know, I never expected to have an office job.
ja: カイン: なあ、オレ、まさかオフィスで働くことになるとは思ってなかったよ。

key: I always felt like, once you turn 20 or whatever, it's over.
en: I always felt like, once you turn 20 or whatever, it's over.
ja: 20歳とかになったら、もう人生終わりだって、ずっとそんな気がしてたんだ。

key: You're gonna blink and wake up one day and you're 65 and hated every moment of it.
en: You're gonna blink and wake up one day and you're 65 and hated every moment of it.
ja: 気づいたら65歳になってて、その間ずっと嫌々過ごしてたって、そんな感じでさ。

key: Like, the 9-5 work day might as well be a prison sentence.
en: Like, the 9-5 work day might as well be a prison sentence.
ja: 9時5時の仕事なんて、懲役みたいなもんだと思ってたんだ。

key: Buuut, I realize now maybe that was a teensy bit overreactive.
en: Buuut, I realize now maybe that was a teensy bit overreactive.
ja: でもまあ、ちょっと大げさすぎたかもって、今は思うけどな。

key: It's easy to get swept up in the idea of months and years passing without your control,
en: It's easy to get swept up in the idea of months and years passing without your control,
ja: 何ヶ月も何年も、自分の手の届かないところで過ぎていくって考えに、飲み込まれるのは簡単なんだよな。

key: Because until that happens, it's just an idea that exists in that instant.
en: Because until that happens, it's just an idea that exists in that instant.
ja: それが実際に起きるまでは、その瞬間にしか存在しない考えでしかないから。

key: But in reality, you still have all of those moments to question, every step of the way, if this is the path you really want to be walking.
en: But in reality, you still have all of those moments to question, every step of the way, if this is the path you really want to be walking.
ja: でも実際には、一歩一歩、これが本当に歩みたい道なのか、問い直せる瞬間はずっとあるんだよな。

key: When you realize you can turn away at any time, it makes it that much easier to take the next step forward.
en: When you realize you can turn away at any time, it makes it that much easier to take the next step forward.
ja: いつでも引き返せるって気づくと、次の一歩を踏み出すのがずっと楽になる。

key: ...At least, that's what I've been thinking.
en: ...At least, that's what I've been thinking.
ja: ……まあ、少なくとも、オレはそう思ってきたんだ。

key: As long as the work is worthwhile, I think I can do that.
en: As long as the work is worthwhile, I think I can do that.
ja: やりがいのある仕事なら、オレはやっていけると思う。

key: And a project like this...
en: And a project like this...
ja: それに、こういうプロジェクトって……

key: The Byxbysion Ward Restoration...
en: The Byxbysion Ward Restoration...
ja: ビクスビジョン区再生計画……

key: Well, that feels pretty important.
en: Well, that feels pretty important.
ja: まあ、けっこう大事なことに思えるんだよな。

key: I'm still a little shaky on calling it 'home',
en: I'm still a little shaky on calling it 'home',
ja: 「地元」って呼ぶのは、まだちょっとしっくりこないけど、

key: But maybe that's only because I was so desperate to get away from there.
en: But maybe that's only because I was so desperate to get away from there.
ja: でもそれは多分、あそこから逃げ出したくて必死だったからなんだろうな。

key: I don't know what it's like to call somewhere home and feel it,
en: I don't know what it's like to call somewhere home and feel it,
ja: どこかを地元だって呼んで、それを実感するのがどんな感じか、オレには分からない。

key: But I think maybe this is how I find out:
en: But I think maybe this is how I find out:
ja: でも、こうやって知っていくのかもしれない。

key: By trying to build one there.
en: By trying to build one there.
ja: そこに、地元ってやつを作ろうとすることでさ。

en: CAIN: ...So, first order of business!
